title: Atmospheric Temp & Monsoon Extremes (1985–2025)
source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2) & GPM IMERG Satellite Archive

records.explanation: 1985 Baseline: Stable 27.1°C temperature with moderate 42mm monsoon rain.
1990: Slight warming (+0.3°C). Pitch rises gently with light rain harmonics.
1995: Noticeable thermal shift to 27.9°C; heavier 68mm cloudbursts trigger brighter chime.
2000: Millennial baseline reaches 28.2°C; mid-frequency synth tone stabilizes.
2005 Spike: Sharp jump to 94.5mm extreme rain! High-pitch raindrop arpeggio activates.
2010 El Niño Effect: 29.3°C heat pushes pitch higher with louder storm resonance.
2015 Record Heat: Near 30°C threshold. High-frequency alert harmonics engage.
2020 Extreme Event: 145mm flash rain burst creates rapid high-pitch acoustic shimmer.
2025 Peak Anomaly: +3.7°C above 1985 baseline. Maximum pitch & full harmonic intensity.
